title: composeStacks: two sub-stacks of one package that each declare one name in a #22934 collection (e.g. `pages`) compose with both entries, so the duplicate refusal never runs
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVLY5efsfaT3UG2zwH

## What happens

`defineStack` refuses two entries under one identity in 27 named collections (#22934, PR #23031: `collectDuplicateEntryErrors`, `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`). That check runs inside `defineStack`'s cross-reference pass only. `composeStacks` concatenates the collections of its inputs (`objectExtensions: 'concat'`, `pages: 'concat'`, … in the compose strategy table) and does not run the check on the composed result. `os validate`, `os build` and `os lint` run the schema-only parse (`ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.safeParse`), which does not run it either.

So two sub-stacks of one package, each passing `defineStack` on its own, compose into one stack holding two entries under one identity, and the boot keeps one of them silently, which is the outcome #22934 exists to prevent. Objects are the exception: `composeStacks` refuses two same-name objects by default (`objectConflict: 'error'`).

Found while measuring #35228 (decision analysis comment 7016526323, premise 5), whose subject is the same gap for `objectExtensions`.

## Measured on main e35cf035 (spec probe, vitest, `packages/spec`)

```ts
const page = (label: string) => ({ name: 'home', label, type: 'app', regions: [] });
composeStacks([
  defineStack({ manifest: { id: 'com.x.app', name: 'crm', version: '1.0.0', type: 'app', namespace: 'crm' }, pages: [page('a')] }, { strict: false }),
  defineStack({ pages: [page('b')] }, { strict: false }),
]);
// → ACCEPTED, composed.pages.length === 2
```

The same shape with one object name in both inputs is REFUSED (`composeStacks conflict: object 'crm_line' is defined in multiple stacks`).

## Measure first (before any fix)

1. For each of the 27 keys in `SAME_STACK_ENTRY_IDENTITY`, compose two `defineStack` inputs of one package that each declare one entry under the same identity. Record whether `composeStacks` accepts, and how many entries the result carries.
2. For the accepted ones, boot the composed stack (source boot and `os build` → artifact boot) and record which entry is served, as #22934's census did.
3. Check `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })` as well: there each input with its own manifest becomes its own `packages[i]` body, where cross-package reuse of a name is allowed (ADR-0048 §3.4). Only same-package collisions are in scope.

## Expected

Whatever the measurement shows, a composition of one package should refuse what `defineStack` refuses for the same package, with the same message. The fix shape for `objectExtensions` is being decided on #35228; this card should follow that ruling for the other keys rather than decide it again.
